```{r loading db}


lire <- function(fichier) {
  s3read_using(
    FUN = read_csv2,
    object = paste0("turismo/", fichier),
    bucket = "mperier",
    opts = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT")),
    locale = locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = "."),
    na = c("", "NA", "..")
  )
}

poblacion_muni <- s3read_using(
  FUN    = read_excel,
  object = "turismo/ieca_export(1).xls",
  bucket = "mperier",
  opts   = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
)


poblacion_muni <- row_to_names(poblacion_muni, row_number = 7) %>% rename(TOTAL = "2025")
v_tur_municipios <- lire("vivienda_tur_municipios.csv") %>% mutate(Total = round(as.numeric(Total))) 
v_tur_prov <- lire("vivienda_tur_prov.csv")%>% mutate(Total = round(as.numeric(Total)))
v_tur_pctge <- lire("vivienda_tur_%.csv") %>% mutate(Total = as.numeric(Total))
```

```{r cleaning}

# Creating date 

noms <- ls(pattern = "^v_tur")

for (n in noms) {
  bdd <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  bdd$date <- as.Date(paste0(sub("M", "-", bdd$Periodo), "-01"))
  bdd$CCAA <- substr(bdd$`Comunidades y Ciudades Autónomas`, 1, 2)
  bdd$Provincia_codigo <- substr(bdd$Provincias, 1, 2)
  
  bdd <- bdd |>
    relocate(CCAA, .before = `Comunidades y Ciudades Autónomas`) |>
    relocate(Provincia_codigo, .before = Provincias)
  
  if ("Municipios" %in% names(bdd)) {
    bdd$codigo_postal <- substr(bdd$Municipios, 1, 5)
    bdd <- relocate(bdd, codigo_postal, .before = Municipios)
  }
  
  assign(n, bdd, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r maps}

base_andalucia <- function(base) {
  base <- base |>
    filter(CCAA == "01",
           !is.na(Provincia_codigo),
           !is.na(Total))
  
  if ("Viviendas y plazas" %in% names(base)) {
    base <- base |> filter(`Viviendas y plazas` == "Viviendas turísticas")
  }
  base
}

df_niveau <- function(base, d) {
  base_andalucia(base) |>
    filter(date == as.Date(d)) |>
    select(Provincia_codigo, valor = Total)
}

df_evolution <- function(base) {
  base_andalucia(base) |>
    group_by(Provincia_codigo) |>
    arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    summarise(valor = round((last(Total) - first(Total)) / first(Total) * 100, 1))
}

joindre <- function(df) {
  prov_andalucia |> left_join(df, by = c("cpro" = "Provincia_codigo"))
}

# Preparation of the map 

carte_prov <- function(carte,
                       legende   = c("continu", "classes"),
                       nom_leg   = "Number",
                       palette   = "Reds",
                       titre     = "",
                       sous_titre = NULL,
                       prefixe   = "",
                       suffixe   = "",
                       n_classes = 4) {
  
  legende <- match.arg(legende)
  
  # Étiquettes : nom + valeur
  carte <- carte |>
    mutate(etiquette = paste0(ine.prov.name, "\n", prefixe,
                              format(valor, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE),
                              suffixe))
  
  # Ajout : proportion entre parenthèses, si la colonne pct existe
  if ("pct" %in% names(carte)) {
    carte <- carte |>
      mutate(etiquette = ifelse(is.na(pct), etiquette,
                                paste0(etiquette, "\n", " (", round(pct, 1), " %)")))
  }
  
  if (legende == "classes") {
    bornes <- unique(classIntervals(carte$valor, n = n_classes, style = "jenks")$brks)
    carte <- carte |>
      mutate(classe = cut(valor, breaks = bornes, include.lowest = TRUE, dig.lab = 6))
    
    p <- ggplot(carte) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = classe), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = palette, na.value = "grey90",
                        name = nom_leg, drop = FALSE)
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(carte) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = valor), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = palette, direction = 1,
                           na.value = "grey90", name = nom_leg)
  }
  
  p +
    geom_sf_text(aes(label = etiquette),
                 size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.9, color = "black") +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    labs(title = titre, subtitle = sous_titre)
}


# Map 1 : nombre de viviendas turísticas en 2026 (avec % entre parenthèses)

df_pct <- df_niveau(v_tur_pctge, "2026-05-01") |>
  rename(pct = valor)

carte1 <- joindre(df_niveau(v_tur_prov, "2026-05-01")) |>
  left_join(df_pct, by = c("cpro" = "Provincia_codigo"))

carte_prov(carte1,
           nom_leg = "Número",
           titre   = "Número de viviendas turísticas por provincia", 
           sous_titre = "(Proporción de viviendas turísticas sobre el total de viviendas)")


# Map 2 : ∆ of vtur 2020-2026
carte_prov(joindre(df_evolution(v_tur_prov)),
           nom_leg = "Growth (%)", prefixe = "+", suffixe = " %",
           titre   = "Growth in touristic housing per province, 2020 to 2026 (%)")

# Map 3 : share of housing that is touristic 

carte_prov(joindre(df_niveau(v_tur_pctge, "2026-05-01")),
           nom_leg = "Share (%)", suffixe = " %",
           palette = "Reds",
           titre   = "Share of touristic housing in total housing per province in 2026")
```

```{r joindre poblacion}

base_andalucia_munic <- function(base) {
  base <- base |>
    filter(CCAA == "01", !is.na(Provincia_codigo),
           !is.na(codigo_postal), !is.na(Total))
  if ("Viviendas y plazas" %in% names(base)) {
    base <- base |> filter(`Viviendas y plazas` == "Viviendas turísticas")
  }
  base
}

joindre_munic <- function(df) {
  munic_andalucia |> left_join(df, by = c("LAU_CODE" = "codigo_postal"))
}

norm <- function(x) {
  x <- stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x <- tolower(trimws(x))
  x <- gsub("\\s*\\(capital\\)", "", x)                         # "granada (capital)" -> "granada"
  x <- sub("^(.*),\\s*(el|la|los|las)$", "\\2 \\1", x)          # "tres villas, las" -> "las tres villas"
  #x <- gsub("-", " ", x)                                        # "zarza-perrunal" = "zarza perrunal"
  gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x))
}

pop <- poblacion_muni |>
  transmute(nom = norm(`Lugar de residencia`),
            poblacion = as.numeric(TOTAL)) |>
  filter(!is.na(poblacion))

# Viviendas turísticas à la date voulue
viv <- base_andalucia_munic(v_tur_municipios) |>
  filter(date == as.Date("2026-05-01")) |>
  transmute(codigo_postal,
            Municipios = substring(Municipios, 7),
            nom = norm(Municipios),
            viviendas = Total)

tab_base <- viv |>
  left_join(pop, by = "nom") |>
  mutate(ratio = round(viviendas / poblacion * 1000, 2))   # pour 1000 habitants (en %)




```

```{r carte por municipio}
carte_muni <- function(carte,
                       legende = c("continu", "classes"),
                       nom_leg = "Number",
                       palette = "Reds",
                       titre   = "",
                       source  = NULL,
                       bornes  = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, Inf),
                       encadre = NULL) {
  
  legende <- match.arg(legende)
  
  if (legende == "classes") {
    
    etiq <- paste0(head(bornes, -1), "-", tail(bornes, -1))
    etiq[length(etiq)] <- paste0(">", tail(head(bornes, -1), 1))
    
    carte <- carte |>
      mutate(classe = cut(valor, breaks = bornes, labels = etiq,
                          include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE))
    
    p <- ggplot(carte) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = classe)) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = palette, na.value = "grey90",
                        name = nom_leg, drop = FALSE)
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(carte) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = valor)) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = palette, direction = 1,
                           na.value = "grey90", name = nom_leg)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30", hjust = 0)) +
    labs(title = titre, caption = source)
  
  # Encadré : en haut à gauche (zone vide au nord de Huelva)
  if (!is.null(encadre)) {
    bb <- sf::st_bbox(carte)
    p <- p +
      annotate("label",
               x = unname(bb["xmax"]), y = unname(bb["ymin"]),
               label = encadre, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
               size = 3, lineheight = 1.1,
               fill = "white", color = "grey20",
               linewidth = 0.3, label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"))
  }
  p
}

carte_muni(joindre_munic(tab_base |> select(codigo_postal, valor = ratio)),
           legende = "classes",
           bornes  = bornes <- c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, Inf),
           nom_leg = "Viviendas turísticas\npor 1000 hab.",
           titre   = "Viviendas turísticas por cada 1000 habitantes, 2026",
           source  = "Fuente: INE, IECA", 
           encadre = "Andalucía\n90 649 viviendas turísticas\n8 666 412 habitantes\n(10,5 por 1.000 hab.)")
```

```{r table of top vt per municipio}


set_flextable_defaults(na_str = "", font.size = 10)

# 1. Top 10 selon le ratio pour 1 000 habitants
top10 <- tab_base |>
  filter(!is.na(ratio), poblacion >= 1000) |>
  slice_max(ratio, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(codigo_postal, Municipios, poblacion, ratio)

# 2. Une date de référence par année : août si elle existe, sinon mai
dates_ref <- v_tur_municipios |>
  distinct(date) |>
  mutate(annee = year(date), mois = month(date)) |>
  filter(mois %in% c(5, 8)) |>
  group_by(annee) |>
  slice_max(mois, n = 1) |>      # 8 > 5 : août gagne s'il est présent
  ungroup()

# 3. Nombre de viviendas turísticas à ces dates, pour les 10 communes
evo <- base_andalucia_munic(v_tur_municipios) |>
  filter(codigo_postal %in% top10$codigo_postal,
         date %in% dates_ref$date) |>
  mutate(annee = year(date),
         Total = ifelse(Total == 1, NA, Total)) %>%
  select(codigo_postal, annee, Total)

annees <- sort(unique(evo$annee))

# 4. Tableau : une colonne par année
a_min <- as.character(min(annees))
a_max <- as.character(max(annees))

tab <- evo |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = annee, values_from = Total) |>
  select(codigo_postal, all_of(as.character(annees))) |>
  left_join(top10, by = "codigo_postal") |>
  arrange(desc(ratio)) |>
  mutate(aug = ifelse(is.na(.data[[a_min]]) | is.na(.data[[a_max]]), "",
                      sprintf("%+.0f %%",
                              (.data[[a_max]] - .data[[a_min]]) / .data[[a_min]] * 100)),
         ratio = round(ratio, 1)) |>
  select(Municipios, all_of(as.character(annees)), aug, poblacion, ratio)

note <- "Datos de agosto de 2020 a 2024; de mayo a partir de 2025."

ft <- flextable(tab) |>
  set_header_labels(Municipios = "Municipio",
                    aug        = "Variación (2020-2026)",
                    poblacion  = "Población (2025)",
                    ratio      = "Por 1.000 hab.") |>
  colformat_num(j = c(as.character(annees), "poblacion"),
                big.mark = " ", digits = 0) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  add_header_lines("Viviendas turísticas en los 10 municipios andaluces con mayor tasa por 1.000 habitantes") |>
  bold(i = 1, part = "header") |>
  fontsize(i = 1, size = 12, part = "header") |>
  align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  add_footer_lines(c(note, "Fuente: INE, IECA")) |> 
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") |>
  color(color = "grey40", part = "footer") |>
  italic(part = "footer") |>
  autofit()

ft 
dir.create("data/output", showWarnings = FALSE)
save_as_image(ft, path = "tabla_top10.png", res = 200)
```

```{r evolution map}


df_ev <- v_tur_prov |>
  filter(CCAA == "01",
         !is.na(Provincia_codigo),
         `Viviendas y plazas` == "Viviendas turísticas",
         !is.na(Total)) |>
  group_by(Provincia_codigo) |>
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(
    debut = first(Total),
    fin   = last(Total),
    valor = round((fin - debut) / debut * 100, 1)
  )

carte_ev <- prov_andalucia |>
  left_join(df_ev, by = c("cpro" = "Provincia_codigo"))

legende <- "continu"   # ou "continu"

if (legende == "classes") {
  
  bornes <- unique(classIntervals(carte_ev$valor, n = 4, style = "jenks")$brks)
  
  carte_ev <- carte_ev |>
    mutate(classe = cut(valor, breaks = bornes, include.lowest = TRUE, dig.lab = 4))
  
  p <- ggplot(carte_ev) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = classe), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Reds", na.value = "grey90",
                      name = "Growth (%)", drop = FALSE)
  
} else {
  
  p <- ggplot(carte_ev) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = valor), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Reds", direction = 1,
                         na.value = "grey90", name = "Growth (%)")
}

carte_ev <- carte_ev |>
  mutate(etiquette = paste0(ine.prov.name, "\n",
                            "+", format(valor, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " %"))

p +
  geom_sf_text(data = carte_ev, aes(label = etiquette),
               size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.9, color = "grey15") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  labs(title = "Growth in touristic housing per province, 2020 to 2026 (%)")
```

Shiny :

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Number of touristic housing per province in Andalucía"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderTextInput("date", "Date",
                      choices = format(dates, "%Y-%m"),
                      selected = format(dates[1], "%Y-%m"),
                      animate = animationOptions(interval = 1000, loop = FALSE))
      ),
    mainPanel(leafletOutput("carte", height = 600))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  donnees <- reactive({
    df <- v_tur_prov |>
      filter(format(date, "%Y-%m") == input$date,
             CCAA == "01",
             !is.na(Provincia_codigo),
             `Viviendas y plazas` == "Viviendas turísticas") |>
      select(Provincia_codigo, valor = Total)
    
    # VOTRE jointure
    prov_andalucia |>
      left_join(df, by = c("cpro" = "Provincia_codigo"))
  })
  
  output$carte <- renderLeaflet({
    carte <- donnees()
    
    # VOS bornes, avec n = 4 ; unique() évite l'erreur de doublons
    bornes <- unique(classIntervals(carte$valor, n = 4, style = "jenks")$brks)
    pal <- colorBin("Blues", domain = carte$valor, bins = bornes,
                    na.color = "#e5e5e5")
    
    etiquettes <- sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>%s",
                          carte$ine.prov.name,
                          format(carte$valor, big.mark = " ")) |>
      lapply(htmltools::HTML)
    
    leaflet(carte) |>
      addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
      addPolygons(
        fillColor = ~pal(valor), fillOpacity = 0.85,
        color = "white", weight = 1,
        label = etiquettes,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#333",
                                            bringToFront = TRUE)
      ) |>
      addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~valor,
                title = "Number of touristic housing",
                position = "bottomright", na.label = "No data")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
